comment: Tuned numbers for the heuristic pipeline explored in ADR-0007. They live
here for the same reason the cost inputs do: they are a choice, and a choice
belongs where it is visible rather than buried in code.
Two of them are grounded in this repo's own reconnaissance runs and two are
not, which is stated rather than smoothed over:
rapid_succession_seconds  ADR-0006 measured gaps under 5s at 2.9% precision
against a 0.516% base rate. Real lift, far too
weak to decline on -- which is why it routes.
hourly_velocity_at        ADR-0002: the busiest card in this data reaches 9
daily_velocity_at         payments in an hour and 36 in a day. These sit
below those ceilings so the rules fire on the tail.
large_amount_usd          Chosen. No run in this repo establishes it.
review_at                 Chosen. 40 means any single strong rule is enough
